propositions: Four criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) have produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs, wasting executions.

Add deterministic pre-gates that skip LLM routing for a criterion only when its subject vocabulary is entirely absent from the plan, keeping the LLM router as the applicability authority for fired plans.

DetGateRule fires when all text_all regexes match plan text, OR any file_impact path matches a glob, OR file_impact_reason_re matches an entry's reason or path; asserted-capability requires both text_all legs to match.
Skipped criteria are recorded via a gate_log threaded into coverage.routing.det_gated in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, keyed by criterion id with rule name.
Existing overlay entries T5a/T5d/T7/T12 migrate to one-element text_all DetGateRule objects as a behavior-preserving conversion verified by a pinning test.
ADR 0034 receives an amendment note recording the conservative pre-filter contract and the zero-findings evidence.
